The test image is a microscopic view (50 µm scale bar) showing:
- Septate, branched conidiophores
- Rounded to obovoid conidia with internal septation (muriform), tan/yellowish-brown
- Size consistent with ~20-50 µm

This is clearly a fungal spore/conidiophore microscopy image. The muriform conidia and branched septate conidiophores strongly suggest **Alternaria**. Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image is nearly identical to the test image — same photographer (Bruce Watt), same 50 µm scale, same Bugwood series (IDs 5505971 vs 5505973). Both show the characteristic septate conidiophores and muriform (multi-septate) conidia of Alternaria. The match is definitive.
